basic_info.title: RNTrajRec: Road Network Enhanced Trajectory Recovery with Spatial-Temporal Transformer
basic_info.authors: Yuqi Chen, Hanyuan Zhang, Weiwei Sun, Baihua Zheng
basic_info.venue: IEEE ICDE 2023 (39th International Conference on Data Engineering), pp. 829-842

gap_analysis.whats_missing: RNTrajRec is supervised: it requires map-matched trajectories (sampled at 10-15s) as ground truth to train the recovery decoder, so it does not satisfy label-free training. There is no RL component; recovery is a one-shot seq2seq decode over the transformer encoding rather than a sequential decision agent acting in latent space. Its graph integration is structural/spatial (GAT over grid-partitioned road sub-graphs), not RDF/KG semantic enrichment.
gap_analysis.reasoning: It is the closest neighbor on the transformer-plus-graph axis (GPSFormer spatial-temporal transformer over per-point road sub-graphs via GridGNN/GAT), but it is supervised and has no latent-space RL, leaving two of the three pillars open.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Directly relevant to fleet GPS analytics: recovers high-resolution map-aligned trajectories from low-sample-rate GPS, the exact preprocessing/enrichment problem in Foresight fleet-trajectory pipelines.
